parameters.name: AgentId
parameters.description: The ID of the agent to update.

parameters.name: Files
parameters.description: The list of files to update.

sub_parameters.name: FileName
sub_parameters.description: The file name. The value must be one of the following allowed file names: AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md, BOOTSTRAP.md, MEMORY.md, or MEMORY.alt.md.

parameters.name: IsDefault
parameters.description: Specifies whether to set the agent as the default agent.

parameters.name: KeepWorkspaceFiles
parameters.description: Specifies whether to keep files when switching the workspace.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The new display name of the agent.

parameters.name: Restart
parameters.description: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after creation. Default value: true.
